title: Swift Dev Intern
description:
Swift Developer Intern - Bangalore (On-site/Hybrid). Duration: 6 Months. As a Swift Developer Intern, you will work closely with our design and development teams to build high-quality, scalable, and user-friendly iOS applications. This internship provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in mobile app development while contributing to real-world projects. 
 Responsibilities 
 Develop and maintain iOS applications using Swift and Apples development frameworks Build intuitive and responsive user interfaces using SwiftUI and/or UIKit Convert UI/UX designs from tools like Figma into functional mobile applications Integrate RESTful APIs and manage data efficiently within the app Ensure optimal performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications Debug, test, and troubleshoot issues to improve app stability Collaborate with backend developers, designers, and product teams Implement version control using Git and GitHub Participate in code reviews and agile development processes Stay updated with the latest iOS development trends and best practices Requirements 
 Basic knowledge of Swift and iOS application development Familiarity with Xcode and Apples development ecosystem Understanding of mobile UI/UX principles and Apple Human Interface Guidelines Knowledge of SwiftUI and/or UIKit Understanding of REST APIs, JSON parsing, and asynchronous programming Familiarity with Git and GitHub Basic understanding of MVC or MVVM architecture Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Good communication and teamwork abilities Eagerness to learn in a fast-paced startup environment Good to Have 
 Experience building iOS apps or academic projects Familiarity with Core Data or UserDefaults Knowledge of Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods Understanding of push notifications and app lifecycle Exposure to Firebase or cloud services Portfolio or GitHub showcasing iOS apps Experience with App Store or TestFlight What You Will Gain 
 Hands-on experience on real-world iOS applications Mentorship from experienced developers Exposure to modern tools and frameworks Strong iOS portfolio development Startup work environment experience Potential full-time opportunity
